question: Why can't the person upload and parse statements in the preview, and how can they test it?
probes: Read the browser-only fallback (upload only records a document, added 0, preview notice) and the real server upload path
Run a standalone logic test of the new sample action: add, list, summary, recategorize, delete
Verify the built screens contain the new action and run rebuild_check
resolution: Superseded: the preview-only generated 'Load sample statement' was removed at the person's explicit request ('NOT A PREVIEW REWRITE'). Replaced by 'Read example statement', which fetches a real bundled BPI-format PDF and parses it with the same engine as uploads — real rows, totals and categories. The bundled example was verified to parse to two correct transactions, with duplicate rejection and full summary/category flow, plus web build, cargo tests and rebuild_check.
